obligations.text: Schema migrations are forward-only.

Each migration has an `up` step and no `down`
step
it runs in its own transaction together with its `user_version` bump.

A
migration that has been merged to `main` is never edited; any change ships as a
new, higher-numbered migration.

SIM refuses to open a dataset whose version is
newer than the build.

Opening an older dataset migrates it forward in memory; the
file on disk changes only when the user saves.
Released datasets keep a stable meaning for each version number.

Every schema
change needs a new migration and tests, even small corrections.

A destructive migration (dropping or narrowing data) would be irreversible once
the user saves; such a migration needs explicit review and a clear warning before
save.

If users need to hand datasets to people on older SIM builds, this decision
should be revisited.
